spans.s: yauvanika, or ˚aka (Skt. Gr. and Lex.), = yauvana, youth (abstract), in cpd.: LV 〔322.3〕 (vs) paribhuñja suyauvanikaṃ (v.l. ˚akaṃ), if m., excellent youth, if f. (Bhvr.), a woman in the bloom of youth; in either case endearing dim., 〔§ 22.34〕.
yauvarājya (-bhūmi), apparently n. of the 9th Bhūmi: [] navamī yauvarājyāto (so mss., except one ˚yatā; read the latter? Senart em. ˚yato) Mv 〔i.76.17〕.
